questions.question: Describe your work developing next-generation intelligent down-hole oil drilling tools. What electrical design decisions were you responsible for, and how did you validate the design in the field or lab?

How have you designed or supported automated test systems using LabVIEW and Python, particularly for calibrating accelerometers and magnetometers? Please walk through the system architecture and your approach to measurement accuracy.

This role involves PLC control systems and control panels. What experience do you have integrating embedded hardware, sensors, or test equipment with control logic, and how would you approach learning or applying a PLC-based architecture?
Give an example of a hardware and software project involving multiple sensors. How did you define interfaces, manage signal integrity or noise, and troubleshoot issues during integration?

What is your experience creating electrical schematics using Cadence Schematic Editor or other CAD tools? How do you ensure that schematics are accurate, reviewable, and ready for downstream implementation?

This position requires extensive application of the National Electrical Code. What experience have you had working with electrical codes, safety requirements, grounding, wiring practices, or design documentation, and how would you verify NEC compliance on a project?

Describe a calibration automation effort you led or significantly contributed to. What was manual before the automation, what did you implement, and how did you assess improvements in repeatability, throughput, or reliability?

How would you approach designing power distribution, motor control, facility conduit, and wiring for an industrial water or wastewater facility when working alongside mechanical and process engineers?

Tell us about a time you found an issue in hardware, firmware, test results, or design data that could have affected product quality. How did you investigate it, document the findings, and drive resolution?

This role includes reviewing construction documents, shop drawings, and supporting facility testing and startup. Based on your product and test engineering experience, what would be your method for reviewing technical submittals and commissioning an electrical/control system?
